title: Asymptotic Fourier norm of odd majority
statement: As $m$ tends to infinity through the natural numbers, the Fourier one-norm of majority on $2m+1$ sign coordinates is asymptotic to $\frac{2}{\sqrt{\pi}}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2m+1}}2^{(2m+1)/2}$.
